headline: Flooding closes schools in Wonorejo, Demak
summary: Sejumlah sekolah di Desa Wonorejo, Kecamatan Karanganyar, Demak, diliburkan karena akses jalan dan ruang kelas terendam. Di TK Bina Putra 1, air di halaman mencapai 70 cm dan siswa belajar di rumah selama dua hari hingga 12 Januari 2026.
summary_id: Sejumlah sekolah di Desa Wonorejo, Kecamatan Karanganyar, Demak, diliburkan karena akses jalan dan ruang kelas terendam. Di TK Bina Putra 1, air di halaman mencapai 70 cm dan siswa belajar di rumah selama dua hari hingga 12 Januari 2026.
summary_en: Several schools in Wonorejo village, Karanganyar district, Demak, were closed because access roads and classrooms were flooded. At TK Bina Putra 1 water in the yard reached 70 cm and pupils studied at home for two days up to 12 January 2026.
